trigger_condition: Tool invoked after execute() signature changed from glob to prefix/recursive
potential_consequence: NameError: 'glob' undefined — every call to these two tools crashes

trigger_condition: Customer config sets features:tool_permissions.min_tool_call_policy to a string value
guard_snippet: floor_policy = ToolCallPolicy(floor_policy) if floor_policy else None
potential_consequence: AttributeError: str has no '.strictness' — every chat request fails once the setting is configured

trigger_condition: AI message contains more than one tool_call in the same step
guard_snippet: pending_event = ToolCallPendingEvent(..., tool_name=', '.join(tc['name'] for tc in tool_calls) ...) or interrupt per-call
potential_consequence: User is shown/confirms only the first tool call; remaining tool_calls execute silently on resume with no individual review

trigger_condition: Graph interrupts before 'tools' but last message in state is not an AIMessage
potential_consequence: AttributeError on '.tool_calls' crashes the streaming request instead of the intended warn-and-skip path

trigger_condition: require_tool_confirmation is True but self.conversation_id is None/empty
guard_snippet: if self.require_tool_confirmation and self.conversation_id: ... else: fall back to per-run InMemorySaver
potential_consequence: Checkpointer keyed on thread_id=None; concurrent conversation-less runs can read/overwrite each other's pending checkpoint

trigger_condition: Two concurrent POST /tool-call/resume requests for the same conversation_id
guard_snippet: acquire per-conversation lock (e.g. SELECT ... FOR UPDATE or Redis lock) before reading/clearing pending_checkpoint
potential_consequence: Race lets the mutating tool call execute twice or corrupts the shared checkpoint row

trigger_condition: pending tool call is cleared/expired between router's _resume_tool_call check and the handler's own get_pending_tool_call call (TOCTOU)
guard_snippet: if pending is None and request.action == ToolCallAction.allow: raise ExtendedHTTPException(404, ...)
potential_consequence: resume_from_interrupt() runs anyway with text='' and history_index=None, silently starting an empty/blank agent invocation

trigger_condition: Conversation is reset while a tool-call confirmation is pending
potential_consequence: Stale pending_tool_call keeps surfacing in ConversationResponse after reset, even though the checkpoint needed to resume it is gone

trigger_condition: LangGraph emits pending/partial writes for a step interrupted before completion (e.g. parallel tool dispatch)
guard_snippet: persist writes keyed by (thread_id, checkpoint_id, task_id) instead of no-op
potential_consequence: Partial step state is discarded; resume can silently lose in-flight write data for that step

trigger_condition: args['method'] is a non-string truthy value (int, list, dict)
potential_consequence: AttributeError from calling .strip() on a non-string crashes is_safe() classification instead of defaulting to unsafe

trigger_condition: A future ToolCallPolicy member is added without an explicit strictness case
potential_consequence: New policy variants silently fall through to strictness 0 (least strict), weakening confirmation requirements without warning

trigger_condition: AI message being resumed had multiple tool_calls but only pending_tool_call_id (the first) is tracked
guard_snippet: replay _on_tool_start for every id in all_tool_call_ids, not just the tracked pending_tool_call_id
potential_consequence: Tool-start thought is never emitted for the other tool calls; their _on_tool_end has no matching in-progress thought to close
